question: Which chapter of the Kāśyapa text concludes with the characteristics of the time-destroying form?
premises: The text is attributed to Aṃśumān in Kāśyapa.
The chapter concerns the characteristics of the time-destroying form.
inference: This marks the end of the seventieth chapter on the time-destroying form in the Kāśyapa text.
plain_english: Thus ends the seventieth chapter, on the characteristics of the time-destroying form, in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
